text: Which word goes in front of 'fly', 'cup' and 'milk' to make three new words?
How many legs do four ducks and two cows have altogether?
Which colour do you get when you mix blue paint with yellow paint?
A pizza is cut into 8 slices and 3 friends eat 2 slices each. How many slices are left over?
A baker cracks a dozen and a half eggs into a big sponge mixture. How many eggs is that?
A bus has 20 passengers. At the first stop 5 get off and 3 get on. At the next, 6 get off and 8 get on. How many are on the bus now?
It's Wednesday today and our holiday starts in exactly 10 days' time. On which weekday does it start?
why: Seven days on is Wednesday again; three more is Saturday.

text: Spot the number that doesn't belong: 9, 16, 25, 30, 36.
Put one letter in front of ONE to make a word meaning 'not any'.
A cooking timer is set for one fifth of an hour. How many minutes is that?
Which month comes three months after November?
Three whole numbers in a row add up to 72. What is the biggest of them?
What is 7 times 8, take away 7 times 7?
A dad is four times as old as his son. In 20 years he'll be only twice as old. How old is the son now?
why: Son 10, dad 40; in 20 years they're 30 and 60.

text: Draw a square and both of its diagonals. How many triangles can you count?
why: Four small triangles, plus four big ones, each half of the square.

text: What is the biggest number that divides exactly into both 24 and 36?
why: 24 = 2 × 12 and 36 = 3 × 12; nothing bigger goes into both.

text: In a leap year, how many days are there from January to March inclusive?
Prime numbers have no factors except 1 and themselves. Which is the next prime after 23?
why: 24 to 28 all divide by 2 or 3 (25 by 5); 29 is prime.

text: Which letter is three places before the letter that comes two after T?
why: Two after T is V; three before V is S.

text: Find the value that should end this sequence: 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, ?
Which word is spelled incorrectly in every dictionary?
why: The word 'incorrectly' is always spelled I-N-C-O-R-R-E-C-T-L-Y.

text: Here's a puzzling sequence: 61, 52, 63, 94, 46. Which number comes after 46?
why: They're the squares 16, 25, 36, 49, 64 written backwards; 81 backwards is 18.

text: Carry on this pattern of numbers: 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, then what?
A wall clock with hands loses 10 minutes every day. How many days until it shows the right time again?
why: It must lose a full 12 hours, 720 minutes: 720 ÷ 10 = 72 days.
